description: Whether this store holds a hospital's prices and, if not, WHY. Look up one hospital by CCN or by name (partial match), or summarise a state, or (no arguments) the whole store, including which states are loaded (the store is loaded state by state, so a hospital in an unloaded state is simply absent). Every hospital in a loaded state has a status: ok (prices held), blocked (its website refuses our requests; we do not evade blocks), not_found (no machine-readable file found), invalid_pointer, soft_404, unsupported_version, too_large, parse_error, no_matching_codes, not_fetched. Use before trusting an empty hospital_price_search, or to answer "does this tool cover Mayo Clinic".

name.description: Hospital name or part of it, e.g. "Mayo Clinic". Up to 25 matches are returned.

state.description: Two-letter state code, e.g. "MN": counts by status for that state.

status.description: With state: list hospitals having this status (e.g. "blocked").

name: hospital_price_coverage

coverage.description: Which states and how many hospitals the store holds

data_as_of.description: File last-updated date, or the store cycle

found.description: Whether at least one priced result was found

hint.description: How to narrow or fix the request

reason.description: Machine-readable reason when found is false

title: Hospital Price Coverage
